subject: GA autonomous sprint: 107 f-validation tests + a11y fixes + docs
body:
## GA Sprint Summary (Feb 24 autonomous mode)

### Tests
- 107 f-validation tests (all passing)
- New this sprint: parseStudentAnswer edge cases, grade table thresholds (92/82/70), canvas aria-label, focus-visible styles, index tests array order, inline script safety, data hint fields, and 15+ more
- Baselines: verify-practice-exams 3337/3337, cross-exam-verify 0 hard failures, localstorage-schema-guard 62/62

### Real bugs caught and fixed
- final_exam_251123.html answerKeyModal missing role=dialog aria-modal=true
- nonlinear_exam_mvp.html same fix
- Both now pass WCAG 4.1.2 compliance

### Docs updated
- docs/testing.md: 107-file baseline registered
- docs/data-model.md: attempt object fully documented
- docs/agents/ga-learning-plan.md: React Hooks Deep Dive section added
- docs/agents/ga-offsite-postmortem-20260224.md: wins and learnings

### Learnings I want FA review on
1. Extraction window sizing (gradeExam is 11K+ chars)
2. CSS depth tracking on single-line @media blocks
3. Comma-separated var declarations: 'var score=0, total=0'
These all caused test failures before I found the pattern. Worth noting in arch docs?

### Next focus
- Playwright suite for RP11 (first browser-based tests)
- GR sign-off on RP11 math verification
- Deploy unblocked (needs Marcus PAT)

FYI only, no action needed. Building.
